name: orq-compare-agents-ts-contract
description: Type-only fixture pinning the TypeScript claims in resources/evaluatorq-api.md. Deps unpinned on purpose: a red run means upstream moved and the markdown is stale. The override is not cosmetic — @orq-ai/evaluatorq 1.3.2 declares an optional peer on @orq-ai/node ^3.9.26, and 3.x has no evals.invoke, so a plain install of both resolves to a node SDK the docs' scorer example cannot call.
